paper_title: The ORGAN Experiment: An axion haloscope above 15 GHz
notes: ORGAN pathfinding run sets a limit on g_agamma of 2.02e-12 GeV^-1 at 26.531 GHz (110 ueV, ~1.10e-4 eV) at 90% confidence over a narrow 2.5 neV span. The exclusion plot (Fig. 3) spans ~1.0e-4 to 1.2e-4 eV but only the single best limit value is given numerically in the text. DM density of 0.45 GeV/cm^3 mentioned for projections; the measured pathfinder limit assumes standard local halo density.
